No documented fields in the checked-in CRD schema.

<a id="kind-workitem-status"></a>
### Status

WorkItemStatus defines the observed state of WorkItem.

| Field | Description | Type | Required | Default | Enum |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`details`](#kind-workitem-status-details) | WorkItemDetails defines nested fields for WorkItem.Details. | `object` | No | - | - |
| `id` | The unique ID of ths work item. | `string` | No | - | - |
| `retryCount` | Number of times this work item is retried. | `integer` | No | - | - |
| `sdkStatus` | The status of the work item. This uses a distinct JSON name so it can coexist with the OSOK status envelope. | `string` | No | - | - |
| [`status`](#kind-workitem-status-status) | - | `object` | Yes | - | - |
| `timeLastUpdated` | The date and time the work item was last updated. (formatted according to RFC3339 (https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc3339)). | `string` | No | - | - |
| `workRequestId` | The OCID of the work request created this work item. | `string` | No | - | - |
